technical_quality: Adequate PA film; L marker present at image top-right confirming conventional orientation; minimal rotation, adequate penetration (spine visible through the mediastinum); right hemidiaphragm elevated with reduced right lung volume, left side adequately inspired.

devices.type: Median sternotomy wires (approximately 6, double loop at the manubrium)
devices.location: Midline, projected over the sternum/upper-mid thoracic spine
Right lung, upper, middle and lower zones, including a curved line from right upper lateral lung toward the hilum and lines along the right lower lateral lung and right cardiac border

devices.type: Surgical vascular clips (several short linear clips)
Three short linear metallic densities (skin staples / clips)
devices.location: Right upper lateral chest wall soft tissue, near axilla

devices.type: Tiny irregular metallic-density speck, uncertain significance (possible small clip or film artifact)
Radiographic side marker 'L' with lead marker
devices.location: Image top-right, over patient's left shoulder region

abnormalities.finding: Band of pleural thickening (about 1 cm thick) along the lateral chest wall with blunting of the costophrenic angle
Reduced right lung volume with elevated right hemidiaphragm
Post-surgical changes: multiple parenchymal staple lines and hilar clips consistent with prior right lung resection; sternotomy wires
Mild hazy increased density in the right lower zone adjacent to the elevated hemidiaphragm (post-operative/pleural)

description_zh: PA 正面胸部X光,影像右上可見 L 側標記。可見胸骨正中切開術鋼絲約 6 條,右肺上、中、下區有多條手術釘合線及右肺門血管夾,右上側胸壁軟組織另見三枚線狀金屬密度(皮膚釘或夾),顯示右側曾接受肺部手術。右側肺容積減少、右橫膈上抬,右肋膈角變鈍,右下側胸壁沿肋骨內緣可見約 1 公分寬的帶狀軟組織密度,符合右側胸膜增厚,以下肺區為主並向中肺區延伸,縱向範圍約 10 公分。左肺清晰、左肋膈角銳利(僅肋膈角處一微小金屬密度點,意義不明),心臟大小在正常範圍,未見氣胸、肋膜積液或胸管。
